scope: User approved exploratory comparisons; not an independent held-out test set
annotation: Five expected behaviors confirmed by user before model runs on 2026-11-23; assistant encoded numeric requirements. Full narration semantics awaits human review.
selection: Keep all failed attempts; no choosing by hidden task answers. First executor-valid candidate is accepted. Baseline budget3 uses the same maximum call budget with executor-format/physical feedback only, never hidden annotations.
baseline_b1: Static relations, keep_pose and explicit per-frame visibility with ordinary inheritance, events=[] in model output; no approach/retreat/hold solver or model repair. Visibility booleans are adapted to existing appearance operations without inferring user intent.
ablations: no_feedback uses saved first Ours response; no_state and fixed_camera use saved accepted response (last response if none accepted), with exactly one mechanism changed. Replays are not new API calls or independent model samples.
freeze: Commit and hashes must be frozen before every batch. Do not tune prompts or thresholds using the exploratory main results.
statistics: Aggregate repeats within task, then source-pair group. Shared source groups make descriptive intervals dependent; no population generalization claim. Never treat three frames as independent samples.
narration: 15–60 characters requested for all methods. Full fact support/naturalness require human annotation; do not score model fact_claims as truth.
human_review: Prepare blinded paired comparisons and two-rater overlap forms; do not invent participants or ratings. User may review later.
main_plan_version: balanced-54-v1: all five confirmed task types, focus in both groups, frozen before any main result
